data.name: Widgets.Camera.Description
data.value: Shows one of your IP cameras live.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.NotConfigured
data.value: Choose a camera in the widget settings

data.name: Widgets.Camera.UpdateRequired
data.value: Update Macro Deck to see this stream

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.CameraDescription
data.value: A camera added on the IP Camera integration page.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.Camera2Description
data.value: Used by the two-camera and four-camera layouts.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.OverlayDescription
data.value: Show a live dot and the age of the last frame on the tile.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.OverlayBackgroundDescription
data.value: Opacity of the dark strip behind the live indicator. 0 hides it.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.ControlsDescription
data.value: Show left, right, up and down buttons for the camera on this cell. They move a Xiaomi or ONVIF camera without leaving the deck. Arrows make the tile claim presses, so Macro Deck skips the tile's Short Press flow; turn them off to let the Short Press and Long Press actions run, or use a press script to keep the arrows.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.ControlsOpacityDescription
data.value: 0 hides the arrows completely, 100 keeps them solid.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.Config.PressScriptDescription
data.value: Run a Macro Deck script when the picture is pressed. A plugin can run scripts but not the tile's Short Press flow, so a script is the way to run actions while the arrows stay.

data.name: Widgets.Camera.PressScript.Unavailable
data.value: The press script could not run.

data.name: Health.Description
data.value: State of every configured camera. Retry starts its source again.

data.name: Setup.Description
data.value: Every camera you add becomes a video stream and a widget source.

data.name: Setup.UrlDescription
data.value: The camera's snapshot, MJPEG or RTSP address. The Mi 360 1080p exposes RTSP after a community firmware hack, and go2rtc can serve it as MJPEG instead.

data.name: Setup.QualityDescription
data.value: A preset sets the frame rate and maximum width. Choose Custom to use the values below.

data.name: Setup.FpsDescription
data.value: How often the camera is read. 5 is smooth enough for a tile and keeps the camera load low.

data.name: Setup.MaxWidthDescription
data.value: Frames are scaled down to this width. 0 keeps the camera's own size.

data.name: Setup.ControlDescription
data.value: How the control actions reach this camera. ONVIF works for most cameras; Xiaomi talks miIO to the camera itself.

data.name: Setup.ControlHostDescription
data.value: The camera's own IP address when the stream goes through a relay such as go2rtc. Leave it empty to control the address of the stream. Required for Xiaomi.

data.name: Setup.ControlTokenDescription
data.value: The 32 character device token from Mi Home, a Xiaomi integration, or a tool such as python-miio. It is stored as a secret and checked against the camera when you save.

data.name: Setup.ControlTokenInvalid
data.value: The Xiaomi token must be 32 hexadecimal characters.

data.name: Setup.ControlTokenCheckFailed
data.value: The camera did not answer with this token. Check the camera address and the Xiaomi token.

data.name: Setup.NameRequired
data.value: Enter a name for the camera.

data.name: Setup.UrlWrongScheme
data.value: Use an http(s) URL for a snapshot or MJPEG camera, or an rtsp URL for an RTSP camera.

data.name: Setup.FpsRange
data.value: Use a frame rate between 1 and 15.

data.name: Setup.FfmpegMissing
data.value: RTSP needs ffmpeg on this computer. Install it, add it to the PATH, then try again.

data.name: Setup.Probe.Unreachable
data.value: No answer from the camera. Check the URL and that the camera is reachable from this computer.

data.name: Setup.Probe.Unauthorized
data.value: The camera refused the username or password.

data.name: Setup.Probe.HttpError
data.value: The camera answered with an error. Check the URL.

data.name: Setup.Probe.NotJpeg
data.value: The URL answered, but not with a JPEG picture. For a go2rtc camera, use the transcoded stream whose name ends in _mjpeg.

data.name: Setup.Probe.NoFrame
data.value: The stream opened but sent no JPEG frame. For go2rtc, add the ffmpeg transcoder and use the _mjpeg stream.

data.name: Setup.Onvif.Description
data.value: Pick a camera found on this network, or enter the URL manually.

data.name: Setup.Onvif.Unknown
data.value: The discovered camera is no longer known. Run the setup again.

data.name: Setup.Onvif.ResolveFailed
data.value: The camera was found, but its stream address could not be read. Check the ONVIF credentials, or enter the URL manually.

data.name: Setup.Onvif.NoStream
data.value: The camera reported no stream address. Enter the URL manually.

data.name: Setup.UnknownStep
data.value: This setup step is no longer available. Close the dialog and start again.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.Description
data.value: Opens the pressed camera widget in a large view.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.NoClient
data.value: There is no screen to open the camera on.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.CameraDescription
data.value: The camera to open in the modal. Leave it on the pressed widget to open the camera of the camera tile that ran the action.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.NoWidget
data.value: This action has to run from a camera widget.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.NotConfigured
data.value: The camera widget has no camera selected.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.ReadFailed
data.value: The camera widget's settings could not be read.

data.name: Actions.ShowCamera.OpenFailed
data.value: The camera view could not be opened.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.Description
data.value: Saves the current picture of the pressed camera as a JPEG.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.FolderDescription
data.value: Where the pictures are written. Empty means Pictures\IP Camera.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.NoWidget
data.value: This action has to run from a camera widget.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.NotConfigured
data.value: The camera widget has no camera selected.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.ReadFailed
data.value: The camera widget's settings could not be read.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.NoFrame
data.value: The camera has not produced a picture yet.

data.name: Actions.SaveSnapshot.SaveFailed
data.value: The snapshot could not be saved.

data.name: Actions.Control.MoveLeft.Description
data.value: Pans the pressed ONVIF camera left for a moment.

data.name: Actions.Control.MoveRight.Description
data.value: Pans the pressed ONVIF camera right for a moment.

data.name: Actions.Control.MoveUp.Description
data.value: Tilts the pressed ONVIF camera up for a moment.

data.name: Actions.Control.MoveDown.Description
data.value: Tilts the pressed ONVIF camera down for a moment.

data.name: Actions.Control.IrAuto.Description
data.value: Lets the pressed ONVIF camera switch its IR filter automatically.

data.name: Actions.Control.IrOn.Description
data.value: Turns on the IR filter of the pressed ONVIF camera.

data.name: Actions.Control.IrOff.Description
data.value: Turns off the IR filter of the pressed ONVIF camera.

data.name: Actions.Control.NoWidget
data.value: This action has to run from a camera widget.

data.name: Actions.Control.NotConfigured
data.value: The camera widget has no camera selected.

data.name: Actions.Control.ReadFailed
data.value: The camera widget's settings could not be read.

data.name: Actions.Control.Failed
data.value: The camera did not accept the control.

data.name: Actions.Control.CameraDescription
data.value: The camera to control. Leave it on the pressed widget to use the camera of the camera tile that ran the action.

data.name: Actions.Control.CameraMissing
data.value: The selected camera no longer exists. Pick it again in the action.

data.name: Actions.Control.Disabled
data.value: Controls are turned off for this camera.

data.name: Actions.Control.XiaomiNotConfigured
data.value: Add the Xiaomi address and token to this camera in its settings.

data.name: Actions.Control.XiaomiFailed
data.value: The Xiaomi camera did not answer the control.

data.name: FolderViews.CameraWall.Description
data.value: Shows the chosen cameras across the whole folder.

data.name: FolderViews.Config.Description
data.value: Choose up to four cameras and one or two columns. A single camera fills the folder.

data.name: FolderViews.Config.Empty
data.value: Choose cameras in the folder settings

data.name: Issues.FfmpegMissing.Description
data.value: At least one camera uses RTSP, which this plugin converts with ffmpeg. Install ffmpeg and add it to the PATH, or set IPCAM_FFMPEG_PATH to the executable.
